annotation.authors_or_issuer: وزارة الاقتصاد الرقمي والريادة (Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship)
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministry adopts ISO 27001 for its information security management system
Information security steering committee chaired by the Secretary General
Policy applies to permanent and temporary staff, contractors and partners
Controls are planned from information security risk assessment and business impact assessment
Staff trained to promote an information security culture
annotation.summary_en: Text of the Jordanian Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship's internal information security policy, despite the title referring to a draft national AI ethics charter consultation. It adopts ISO 27001, sets a steering committee, and bases controls on risk assessment. It has no AI or robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: الاقتصاد الرقمي تطرح مسودة الميثاق الوطني لأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي للاستشارة العامة (سياسة أمن المعلومات)
annotation.title_en: Digital Economy Ministry Releases Draft National Charter on AI Ethics for Public Consultation (text: Information Security Policy)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (modee.gov.jo)
